title: Pastel Claymorphism
description: Un style de rendu 3D minimaliste caractérisé par des matériaux mats et doux, des bords géométriques arrondis et une palette pastel. L'éclairage repose sur une lumière de studio diffuse avec une douce occlusion ambiante et un grain de rendu uniforme.
prompt: Minimalist 3D render in a soft claymorphism style. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The visual language relies entirely on soft, matte materials, heavily beveled edges, and rounded geometry with zero sharp angles or harsh outlines. Color palette utilizes {{primary_color}} as the dominant base, with {{accent_color}} and {{secondary_color}} providing low-contrast, pastel-toned harmonies. Illumination is driven by diffuse softbox studio lighting, creating high-key, gentle illumination with extremely soft ambient occlusion, smooth gradient drop shadows, and subtle subsurface scattering on semi-opaque elements. Surfaces exhibit zero specular highlights, glossy reflections, or metallic sheen, favoring opaque plastics, frosted translucency, and chalky matte finishes. A subtle, uniform render grain or fine noise texture is applied globally across the entire image, unifying the lighting and materials. Spatial dynamics suggest a clean, pristine environment with flawless topology, often utilizing an isometric or slightly elevated perspective. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. 3d render, claymorphism, pastel palette, matte finish, soft lighting, rounded geometry, minimalist, isometric perspective, subtle grain, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame.

video.motion: Elements should hover, rotate, or slide with smooth, easing, low-velocity physics.
video.camera: Slow, linear dolly or gentle isometric panning with a locked focal length.
video.temporal_texture: The subtle render grain must remain consistent and uniform, while matte reflections and soft shadows shift smoothly without flickering.
